content.what_it_is: Top-level FUNWAVE_TVD driver program (L56-L339). It initializes MPI, reads configuration, optionally restores hot-start time, indexes and allocates the decomposed domain, initializes wave/tide machinery, then advances while TIME<TOTAL_TIME. Each step emits due output, exchanges halos, estimates DT, refreshes tidal/time-spectrum forcing, executes three stages of dispersion/flux/source/update-mask/breaking/boundary work, performs mixing and extrema/blow-up checks, flushes stations after exit, reports wall time, and finalizes MPI (L160-L339). Lines 342-406 are comments defining the meanings of shared hydrodynamic and reconstructed flux variables.

unresolved: READ_INPUT exposes configurable Time_Scheme (io.f90 L1739-L1746), but this driver unconditionally labels and executes a three-stage loop at L254-L255. Whether ESTIMATE_HUV alone makes non-Runge_Kutta selections coherent is not visible here; fluxes, sources, breaking, exchanges, and boundary calls still execute three times regardless.

OUTPUT is called only at the beginning of each TIME<TOTAL_TIME iteration (L209-L213). After the final step exits the loop, only STATIONS receives an explicit final call (L320-L324); no final PREVIEW/OUTPUT call is visible, so a requested field snapshot exactly at TOTAL_TIME depends on ESTIMATE_DT/output-counter behavior outside this file and can be omitted if the last state first reaches TOTAL_TIME inside the step.
